cases.name: Danicka Marie Bergeson
cases.about:
She was a U.S. Army veteran. "She had a huge smile. Really engaging," Danicka's father, David Bergeson, told KARE 11. "Everything with her was always black or white. She knew exactly what was right and wrong. She never broke the rules. She really had a hard time with that."

Her obituary said, "Danicka's life was marked by her unwavering commitment to serving others and her remarkable accomplishments. She embarked on a noble journey in the U.S. military, where she served as a dedicated field medic and later went on to earn her bachelor's degree in animal science from the University of Minnesota in 2007.

Danicka's selfless dedication and spirit in the line of duty were evident throughout her military career. She served her country with pride and honor and created long-lasting friendships with her fellow servicemen and women.

Beyond her military service, Danicka's love for animals was evident to all who knew her. Her knowledge and dedication to animal welfare served as an inspiration to those around her."
cases.narrative:
On 7/7/2023, during a search of her apartment, police observed a lump in the bedding in the primary bedroom. According to the complaint, an officer pulled back the comforter on the bed and found her deceased and wrapped in several other blankets. Her head was covered with a plastic garbage bag.

An autopsy revealed Bergeson sustained severe bruising and abrasions all over her body, and investigators believe she had been deceased in her home for a day or more when officers found her.
